caption: The drawing depicts a single fireplace bellows with a heart-shaped body and two yellow handles. The body is decorated with a prominent yellow panel featuring a floral design; the flowers are primarily red, with some accents of green, black, and brown, and include stylized leaves and stem patterns. The edges of the bellows are bordered with a band adorned with alternating black and red triangle motifs and are fastened with visible silver or grey metal rivets. The nozzle at the end is metallic, colored in gold with light brown shading and detailing. The background is plain and off-white, devoid of any additional objects or textures.
title: Painted Bellows
